# cowlib 2.21.0 is the newest release and the fix for this one is upstream in
# 4401b858f2229abb3ea115c60924f6c77e5f8aa3 only, so there is no version to move
# to yet. It is an escape_string/2 issue in cow_http_struct_hd. Here cowlib
# arrives through mcl_om, whose /health listener is cowboy ~> 2.12: this service
# answers /health over HTTP, but I have not traced a header value that a caller
# influences into escape_string/2, which is why the row is a waiver and not a
# claim that the path is unreachable. Replace this row with the bump on the
# cowlib release that carries the fix, and no later than the date below. Tracked
# for every Erlang and Elixir repository that adopts the advisory gate:
# macula-io/macula#152.
